[5:14PM] #VI #Lekki #TrafficUpdate 

Traffic from McWen Bridge, both inward and outward Bonny Camp Roundabout, is smooth at this time. Movement along Ahmadu Bello Way in both directions, en route to Eko Hotel and back, is also good. From Bonny Camp Underbridge through Kofo Abayomi, Oniru Kilimanjaro, and down to the Ozumba stretch, traffic is good in both directions, with only minor delays caused by traffic light intervals and necessary alternations.

Inward Law School, towards Adeyemo Alakija, is experiencing slow movement due to an ongoing event at Muri Okunola Park, with traffic officers on ground managing the situation. The stretch from Law School to Civic Center, BJ 1004, School Corner, and onward to Sandfield in the direction of Lekki Phase 1 and return, is moving steadily, with slight holdups at alternation points. 

At present, no impediments have been sighted along the major expressways. Our officers are visibly on ground ensuring smooth vehicular movement. 

#FollowLASTMA

[5:28PM] #IjuIshaga #TrafficUpdate 

Fagba Intersection remains clear, with movement in and out of Amala Junction towards Jonathan Coker in good condition. The stretch along Iju Road down to Agege Pen Cinema is experiencing fast movement, and the return trip towards College is equally smooth.

Traffic from Hospital Road to African Church School Junction is moving well, while Idi Agbon, Orimolade, Haruna, and the stretch to Yaya Abatan Junction are all good. Ajayi Road, both inward and outward Excellence Hotel Roundabout, is moving as expected, with a fast flow from there back to Jungle.

Movement from Jungle to Fagba Intersection is swift, as is traffic inward Ishaga Roundabout, although Toyin is slightly busy at that end. The return journey from Ishaga to Fagba is also fast at the moment.

No impediments have been observed along the route, and our men are actively present and working to ensure ease of movement.

#FollowLASTMA
